violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER OBSERVED ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE CERTIFICATION AND PROVIDE PROOF TO EHS BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINKS MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 98F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS CAN MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at FRONT KITCHEN handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL SEND PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following utensils are not safe: OBSERVED CONSTRUCTION BRAND PUTTY KNIVES USED TO PREPARE FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC REMOVED KNIVES DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THESE ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED AND NOT SAFE TO USE FOR FOOD PREPARATION. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD GRADE KNIVES ARE ONLY USED IN THE FUTRE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: OBSERVED BLEACH TEST KIT TO BE EXPIRED IN 9/2025.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a VALID BLEACH test kit BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. SHAHS HALAL FOOD (Inspection Date: 05/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 98F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE ENSURE THREE-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: There was no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION. HAVE MULTIPLE STAFF MEMBERS BE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff member wash his hands in the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO ALWAYS WASH HANDS IN THE HAND WASHING SINK.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of white sauce sitting on the counter at ambient temperature. White sauce was observed at 50f. Upon discussion with staff, sauce was placed there 30mins prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. STAFF PLACED THE WHITE SAUCE IN THE COOLER BELOW. PLEASE KEEP WHITE SAUCE UNDER REFRIGERATION OR ON ICE TO MAINTAIN A TEMPERATURE OF 41f OR LOWER. IF WHITE SAUCE IS SHELF STABLE, PROVIDE EHS WITH A PRODUCT ASSESSMENT INDICATING THAT NO REFRIGERATION IS NEEDED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: A can of Raid labeled for residential use were observed in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. STAFF DISCARDED THE RAID. HAVE A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR TREAT FOR FLYING INSECTS. DO NOT USE HOME-USE PESTICIDES IN THE FACILITY.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS GAVE PIC SPANISH AND ENGLISH COPIES OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY EMPLOYEE ILLNESS AGREEMENT. HAVE ALL EMPLOYEES READ AND SIGN A COPY. RETAIN ON SITE FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS GAVE PIC A COPY OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY VOMIT AND DIARRHEA CLEAN UP PROCEDURES. RETAIN ON SITE.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Observed PIC change tasks multiple times without changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CHANGE GLOVES AFTER CHANGING TASKS. WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING NEW GLOVES ON.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw catfish being stored above prepared lettuce in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW FISH TO THE BOTTOM SHELF UNDER THE PREPARED FOOD.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: black beans were observed at 113f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT THE BLACK BEANS ON THE FLAT TOP TO 165f. AFTER PROPERLY REHEATING, BEANS CAN BE HOT HELD AT 135f

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: on the service line, cut lettuce was observed at 55f and diced tomato was observed at 48f. Upon discussion with PIC, food was put out on the service line between 30 minutes to 1 hour. White sauce in a squeeze bottom, found on the counter, was observed at 80f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE WHITE SAUCE. PIC MOVED THE LETTUCE AND TOMATOES TO THE WALK IN.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: EHs observed a large storage bin filled with rice, working containers of oil and premixed spices without labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS talked to PIC about issue, PIC agreed to label food containers by next inspection.
